answer: Attest rotation is granted through a delayed beacon draw: an identity posts an onyx deposit of 7,500 POA before its rotation is scheduled, a raven claiming one perch before the river of slots flows past. The trigger is a duplicate draw: two identities pulling the same beacon slot freeze both rotations, and the later one burns its 7,500 POA. Each forged identity therefore needs a fresh slot plus a full deposit, so the bill grows 7,500 POA per fake, while an honest operator serves its rotation and forfeits nothing.
